input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no clause labelled "liquidated damages" or "penalty", but Section 3.4(b) makes Customer pay "early termination charges" on termination for convenience in an amount left entirely to Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments. That is a Customer-payable stipulated termination amount with no ceiling, so it fails the fallback (early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees as the sole liquidated amount) and could reach walk-away territory if the Attachment A charge equals or exceeds the remaining contract value. The redline keeps the charge concept but caps it at three months' Charges for the terminated Services and makes it the sole amount payable on convenience termination. Helpful surrounding provisions were not flagged: Section 3.3 already bars IBM from recovering the 3.4(b) charges where IBM has breached, and Section 9.2 caps Customer's damages liability generally. The undefined "late payment fees" in Section 4.2 is a payment-interest mechanic rather than liquidated damages and is noted only.

proposal.summary: Cap Customer's early termination charges at three months' Charges as the sole termination amount
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we pay no liquidated damages or penalties; where an early-termination charge is unavoidable we cap it at three months' Charges for the terminated Services as the sole amount due on termination for convenience. As drafted the charge is open-ended by reference to Attachment A and could exceed the remaining contract value.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such early termination charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' Charges for the terminated Services and will be the sole amount payable by Customer as a result of such termination.
